purpose: Qualify the supervised target semantics for P(active) before any V09B model fitting. This contract evaluates source meaning and chronology, not model performance.

target_definition.positive_class: player was eligible/active for the specific game after the official game-day inactive declaration
target_definition.negative_class: player appeared on the club's official game-day inactive list for the specific game
target_definition.target_observation_time: official game-day inactive declaration, approximately 90 minutes before scheduled kickoff
target_definition.rationale: The target is a later pregame state being forecast from T-120 information; it is not an input feature.

prohibited_target_proxies: postgame participation tables used as active inference
injury game-status designation treated as active/inactive truth
weekly roster eligibility status treated as game-day inactive truth without an independent semantic crosswalk

nflverse_weekly_roster_status.source: nflverse weekly rosters / NFL Shield v2 API
nflverse_weekly_roster_status.documented_status_semantics: Roster-status dictionary defines INA as 'Under contract but not on the active roster, inactive'; the upstream builder selects player_status from the Shield roster API.
nflverse_weekly_roster_status.failure_reason: This is roster eligibility/status semantics, not proven to be the per-game 90-minute inactive declaration. Current weekly assets are retrospective builds and provide no source-level guarantee that INA is identical to the official game-day inactive list for each game.
nflverse_weekly_roster_status.allowed_use: May be used only as an independent roster-state diagnostic/crosscheck after another game-specific label source is qualified; it cannot create P(active) labels by itself.

official_game_day_administration_inactiv.source: NFL Game Day Administration Report / official inactive list
official_game_day_administration_inactiv.semantic_basis: NFL Football Operations states that club PR representatives deliver Game Day Administration Reports containing each club's inactive list at the 90-minute officiating meeting.
remaining_requirements: identify a reproducible historical archive for 2012-2021
pin source hashes or equivalent immutable provenance
measure unresolved identity and duplicate rates

official_nfl_gamebook_not_active_section.source: Official NFL Game Book 'Not Active' section
official_nfl_gamebook_not_active_section.semantic_basis: NFL game books distinguish Did Not Play from Not Active. This is potentially the archived representation of the game-day inactive declaration rather than realized participation.
remaining_requirements: prove the Not Active section is a faithful transcription of the official inactive list rather than a postgame reclassification
measure complete regular-season coverage before authorization
